const { test } = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const { total } = require('./calculator.cjs');
test('empty cart', () => assert.equal(total([]), 0));
test('quantities', () => assert.equal(total([{ price: 3, quantity: 2 }, { price: 4, quantity: 3 }]), 18));
test('zero quantity', () => assert.equal(total([{ price: 8, quantity: 0 }]), 0));
